name: Volopay
summary: Volopay offers virtual cards for online payments and physical cards for travelers, with pre-approval policies and fund requests that approvers can accept or deny. Policies can be set for specific departments and budgets. Its US pricing page lists a Premium card plan and an accounts payable plan without amounts, so buyers need a quote.

facts.text: Volopay says employees can request funds and approvers can approve or deny them with a click, and describes a pre-approval policy so expenses are sanctioned before they are incurred.
The US pricing page lists a Premium card plan with a physical card per user, virtual cards and multi-level approval.
The US pricing page says payment services for US customers are provided by Airwallex US, LLC.
The accounts payable plan lists a $0 domestic transfer fee and an international transfer fee with no amount.

plans.name: Premium card
plans.notes: Physical card per user, virtual cards and multi-level approval. No amount is published and the call to action is Talk to sales

plans.name: Accounts payable automation
plans.notes: Multi-level approval, $0 domestic transfer fee and a low international transfer fee with no amount given

hiddenCosts: The international transfer fee on the accounts payable plan has no published amount.
The pricing page shows no card fees and no free trial.
